- `openrail`: "openrail" names the OpenRAIL family, not one license: the text differs per repo, so each repo's own license text is read (matched by its sha256).
- `bigscience-bloom-rail-1.0`: BigScience BLOOM RAIL 1.0: no copy of the text could be fetched on 2026-11-15; not read yet.
- `other`: Matched by the hash of its text or the declared license name; otherwise not reviewed.
- Any other license id or license text no person has read, and a base model that declares no license.
- Any repo Hugging Face marks gated is link only, whatever its license.
- No license declared: refused.
- 104 license texts a person has read are matched by the sha256 of the text.
<!-- license-table:end -->

## How a verdict is reached

Each entry records how its license verdict was reached (`audit.method`):

- `tag`: the publisher's own license tag is on the table and marked for tag use. No person read it. The model page says "license as declared by the publisher".
- `text-hash`: the license text has the same sha256 as a text a person already read.
- `inherited`: the base model has a stricter verdict than the entry, so the base model's verdict applies.
- `reviewed`: a person read this repo's license and recorded the result.
- `queue`: none of the above. The entry is listed as a link only with "License not reviewed. Read it on the publisher's page." Texts are grouped by their sha256, so one later read clears every repo that ships the same text.

The strictest verdict along base model, fine-tune and quantization wins. A quantization of a refused base model is refused, whatever its own tag says. A quantization with no license tag of its own takes its base model's verdict, because a quantizer cannot relicense the weights. A base model that declares no license makes its derivatives link only as "License not reviewed", not refused.

## Hosted or from the publisher

If Hugging Face lists a repo, Freeweights lists it. The license decides only how:

- **Hosted (signed).** The license allows copies with no acceptance gate and no territory limit. The entry has a signed manifest, and the license file goes in the manifest's files when the repo has one.
- **From the publisher (link only).** The entry shows the facts and links to the publisher's page. No manifest, no copy. The entry says why: gated (accept the license at the source), non-commercial, territory-limited, copyleft, a barred derivative, or license not reviewed.

## Custom licenses

A custom or community license is hosted only after:

1. A person reads it once and records the result in the table, with the sha256 of the text or the declared license name.
2. The model page shows the license and its terms before download, and the commands stay folded until you open them.
3. The license lets a third party redistribute, with no acceptance gate and no territory limit. Otherwise the entry is link only.

Hosted with terms on the entry: OpenMDW 1.1 (keep the agreement and copyright notices with the files), LFM 1.0 (commercial use only for organisations under US$10M annual revenue) and OpenRAIL++-M (the use restrictions in Attachment A pass on to you).

## Non-commercial licenses

Listed with a link to the source only. Freeweights never hosts a copy, and Allternit does not run these models commercially. A declared license name that says non-commercial counts as non-commercial.

## Refusals

- No license at all. (Licenses that allow no redistribution are no longer refused: they are link only, labelled non-commercial, since a link copies nothing.)
- A license that excludes where we host from is no longer refused: it is link only, labelled territory-limited.
- Every refusal is logged: model, source, license found, date and reason. The log is public on the Wanted page.

## Gated repos

A repo behind a login, an access form or an acceptance gate at the source is listed as a link only. We do not copy gated files and we do not bypass a gate. A repo that becomes gated after it was listed becomes link-only on the next sync. Llama 2, 3.x and 4, Gemma and DINOv3 licenses are gated: link only, whatever Hugging Face shows.

## Rules for every listing

- The license text and a checksum are shown with every file.
- A license change at the source is checked on each sync. A change to a license off the table makes the model link only as "License not reviewed".

## Open decisions (Allternit)

- Other OpenRAIL licenses (BigScience BLOOM RAIL, the generic `openrail` tag): link only as not reviewed until a person reads them.
- Decided 2026-11-16: GPL, LGPL and AGPL for weights are link only ("Copyleft license: link only"), never hosted. CC BY-ND 4.0 hosts only an unchanged original; any quantization, fine-tune, merge or adapter is link only ("Barred derivative"). Licenses that allow no redistribution are link only as non-commercial, since a link copies nothing. Registration-before-commercial-use licenses stay gated until Allternit registers.

## Verify with counsel

- Whether each listed license allows hosting and mirroring of weights as we do it.
- Click-through wording and how we record acceptance without storing personal data.
- Treatment of licenses that cover code and weights differently.
